messages:
emily: planning a short-burst rollout in the 03:00 change window. pinning router+runtime+console for deterministic behavior. starting at 5% traffic, ramp to 25% then 100% if stable. rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 200ms sustained for 10m. deploy command below, deploybot will post status updates.

emily: command I'm going to run:
```
/deploy --wave short-burst --pin router=v2.1 runtime=v5.4 console=v3.2.100 --waves 5,25,100 --timeout 20m
```

deploybot: queued: short-burst roll (id=rb-20240315-09). targets: router:v2.1, runtime:v5.4, console:v3.2.100. wave plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. expected duration ~ 15m. will post wave results as they complete.

matt: +1. console team: any schema / client contract risks?

hana: no DB migrations in this change. console UI contract is backward compatible. we did a runthrough with staging last night.

console-shez: dashboards updated (console -> deploy_shortburst). alert hooks wired to #eng-sre. I'll watch logs for any schema errors.

deploybot: stage 1 complete (router:v2.1 @5%). metrics snapshot: 5xx=0.02%, 4xx stable, p95 latency delta +10ms. no anomalous errors.

sre-oncall: watching infra metrics. set temporary alert: 5xx >= 0.5% -> page. p95 delta threshold 200ms -> treat as degrade. I'll escalate if thresholds hit.

matt: who will call rollback? need to know immediate owner if we cross thresholds.

emily: I'll make the rollback call for this burst. if I signal rollback, matt can help unpin console and deploybot will orchestrate router rollback.

matt: I can unpin console quickly. router rollback will be deploybot /deploy rollback-router rb-20240315-09? confirm exact command if needed.

deploybot: stage 2 ramp starting -> moving to 25% (rb-20240315-09, wave 2). ETA ~6m.

deploybot: stage 2 metrics (initial): p95 +220ms, 5xx=0.4%, CPU per-host +8%. traces show increased tail latency on runtime-hosts.

sre-oncall: p95 crossed 200ms threshold. 5xx still below 0.5% but latency is concerning. recommend pause and quick collection of traces/flamegraphs.

hana: agree pause. console traces show slow KV lookups from runtime; kernel batching flag might be interacting with quantized path. recommend pausing ramp and switching routing to fallback quantized model slot (slot-2) for verification.

emily: pausing ramp now. do NOT rollback yet — we want traces. rule: if p95 > 200ms for 10m continuously OR 5xx >= 0.5% then rollback. open runbook and attach traces.

deploybot: ramp paused at 25% (rb-20240315-09). current state: router:v2.1 at 25%, runtime:v5.4 partial, console:v3.2.100 at 25%. to resume: `/deploy continue rb-20240315-09`. to rollback: `/deploy rollback rb-20240315-09` (subcommands for per-service rollback available).

matt: copying runbook steps to the thread. I'll prep console unpin commands and pre-authorize a quick rollback path if emily gives the go.

console-shez: I'll flip the fallback to slot-2 and watch latency for the next 5 minutes, will post numbers.

sre-oncall: collecting flamegraphs now, also grabbing kernel/batching stats. posting link: https://internal.grafana/rb-20240315-09/traces (will be shorter-lived link).

emily: thanks team. holding here until we see 10m of stable p95 under threshold or a trigger for rollback. matt/hana, be ready to execute rollback within 3m if I call it.

matt: noted. standing by.

console-shez: fallback flipped -> observing p95 delta dropping to +40ms after ~90s. 5xx still 0.38%.

sre-oncall: flamegraphs indicate hot path in runtime attention kernel. raised an ops ticket for a quick kernel flag toggle, will coordinate if needed.

emily: if p95 continues to improve, we'll resume. if not, we'll rollback. keep monitoring and post updates.

matt: thanks all. I'll document the rollback steps in the release note for handoff.
